candidates.title: Review rejected workflow template submissions

demandEvidence.chore: Get guidance on correcting a workflow-template submission after three rejections.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’m looking for some guidance regarding a workflow template submission that has been rejected three times.

ease.reason: A student could compare an operator-supplied template and rejection notes in a checklist, but no implementation reference or criteria are supplied.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: workflow consultants may pay for submission-review help; this request establishes no buyer, repeat demand or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock could summarize supplied feedback into a checklist, but actual rejection criteria and useful accuracy are unknown.

autonomy.reason: A draft checklist could be generated from supplied notes, but a person must interpret criteria and revise and resubmit the template.

evidence.reason: The fresh request literally establishes repeated rejection and a request for guidance; it gives no criteria, recurrence beyond this case or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed the bounded proposed output of a feedback-based checklist; the source establishes a request for guidance after three rejections, but not the rejection criteria or whether an AI summary would help. Provisional mean is below 6.

rejected.title: Guidance for a rejected workflow template
rejected.reason: Below threshold: the fresh request supports assessing a proposed checklist from operator-supplied rejection notes, but gives no criteria, implementation evidence or demonstrated repeat demand; provisional mean is below 6.

rejected.title: Private support ticket access
rejected.reason: The retrieved source text is only the generic form prompt ‘What is the problem & what have you tried?’ It gives no actual problem or task. The title suggests a private support ticket, but that cannot substitute for missing primary evidence or justify inventing a workflow.

rejected.title: Billing support after cancellation
rejected.reason: The retrieved source text is only the generic form prompt ‘What is the problem & what have you tried?’ It gives no actual billing issue or task. The title cannot establish the claimed recurring charges or a useful automation chore, so a proposed workflow would be invented.
